objective: Test whether ATXY-addressed KV pages can carry a separately validated per-layer/per-KV-head linear latent before any codebook or routing experiment.

fit.key_basis: For each layer/KV head: eigendecompose 0.5 times mean uncentered post-RoPE K second moment plus 0.5 times mean uncentered post-RoPE Q second moment across its two GQA query heads.
fit.value_basis: For each layer/KV head: centered PCA with one retained float32 value mean.
fit.rank_nesting: Fit once at rank 128 and use leading prefixes without refitting.

decision_rule: A joint arm passes only if its dimensional 40,960-token net ratio and every quality threshold pass both overall and in each selected layer. Passing authorizes only a separately versioned ATXY latent-codebook experiment, never a live cache or context extension.
